end.summary:
Practised inside/outside, top/bottom, on/under, and near/far using objects and pictures.
Shaurya gave 4/4 unaided inside/outside responses and 5/5 top/bottom or on/under responses.
Shaurya gave 2/2 unaided near/far comparisons.
Left/right and in-front/behind relative to a person’s facing direction were introduced; the left/right mix-up remained at the last seen response.
end.parentNote: Asha practised position words with Shaurya, including andar/bahar, upar/neeche, paas/door, and on/under. Shaurya used the container, vertical-position, and distance words correctly through the lesson. They mixed up whether left and right change with the person’s facing direction, and this was not corrected in the last response. At home, place a toy beside a person or drawing, turn the person around, and ask which side the toy is on.
